title: 初三短对话：便签与白霜
source_notice: 初三公开普通期末转载完整题面/印本脚本/参考键已核，原音轨明确缺；地域学年学期只在标题，正文只见九年级英语，原校认证未建立，不当gold。本稿完整原创配套不补平原录音缺口。
timing_notice: 每段两遍；原卷未印精确停顿，本机听前后每题5秒及重播提示属审阅编排
instruction: 听五段短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍。原卷未印精确停顿，本机每题听前后各5秒，只作审阅编排。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You always remember what to buy. Do you keep a list on your phone?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I used to, but now I stick a note on the fridge. I look at it before leaving home.

questions.stem: How does the boy remember his shopping now?
options: By reading a note on the fridge.
questions.rationale: A：明确now用冰箱便签；B：是过去方法；C：未提姐姐提醒

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Is that silver watch yours, Kate?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. It is my brother's. Dad gave it to him, and he let me wear it for the concert.

questions.rationale: A：是送表者；B：明确brother's；C：只是获准借戴

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The grass is white this morning. Will it snow again tomorrow?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, that is frost, not snow. The forecast says tomorrow will be sunny, with rain returning on Friday.

questions.stem: What is the forecast for tomorrow?
questions.rationale: A：雨是周五；B：白霜不是雪且没有预报明日雪；C：明确明日晴

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I cannot upload my project. The school website will not accept the file.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: It may be too large. Try making the photographs smaller before you send it again.

questions.rationale: A：未建议打印；B：明确缩小照片再上传；C：未谈改主题

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I am writing a talk about how we save water at home. Can I describe your rain barrel, Dad?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Of course. Explain that we use its water for the garden, instead of turning on the outside tap.

questions.stem: What is the girl's talk about?
questions.rationale: A：明确saving water at home；B：花园只是用水对象；C：未建围墙
